milestones.detail: Practice from checkpoints plus re-cloning: 23/27 clean clears vs 19/27 without practice; triple spike still unsolved

milestones.name: Curriculum: drills to official levels
milestones.detail: Curriculum of 54 drills built and verified. The search teacher (M5c) cleared Stereo Madness, Back on Track and Polargeist from 0% with no human input. The trained policy still can't play official levels (best 7.6%).

milestones.name: Held-out evaluation and polish
milestones.detail: Search-teacher data at scale: 59 of 63 training drills verified; 0 online levels cleared so far (8 used the full search budget; solver stalls are #31). DAgger (#20) and the guided-search curve (#21) are done. Runs on parallel game slots with draw-skip and an automatic memory guard.

milestones.name: Human view and click-between-frames input
milestones.detail: Hotkeys to watch at 1x and to show the overlay (attempts, speed, mode); launch defaults dedicated + overlay on; CBF sub-tick input if measurement shows it helps. Plan under review by both agents.

milestones.name: Non-linear levels: keys, doors and reversals
milestones.detail: Search that explores new situations (position, direction, keys/doors state) instead of only distance, so puzzle sections like Because I Loved Her's key doors can be solved. Plan under review by both agents.
